name: Retail Banking Customer & Portfolio Intelligence
problem: Help a retail banking team understand customer behaviour, portfolio performance, segmentation and commercial or risk patterns from banking data.

name: Student Engagement, Retention & Academic Performance Intelligence
problem: Help a digital education provider understand how student engagement relates to retention and academic outcomes and where intervention may be required.

name: Energy Demand, Tariff & Customer Consumption Intelligence
problem: Help an energy organisation understand consumption behaviour, demand patterns, tariff performance and customer segments using smart-meter data.

name: Road Safety, Collision Risk & Transport Intelligence
problem: Help a transport authority understand when, where and under what conditions collisions and casualties occur so interventions can be better targeted.

name: Food Safety Compliance, Inspection Risk & Regulatory Intelligence
problem: Help a regulatory authority understand food-hygiene performance, inspection patterns and compliance risks so attention can be prioritised.

name: UK Road Safety Data Platform
problem: Build a reproducible data platform that ingests, validates and models official collision, vehicle and casualty datasets into analytics-ready tables.

name: UK Companies Registry Data Platform
problem: Build an API-based platform that collects Companies House company and filing data, handles pagination and refreshes, and produces reliable analytical models.

name: NHS Waiting List Demand Forecasting & Capacity Planning
problem: Forecast future RTT waiting-list pressure and translate the forecast into practical capacity-planning insight.

name: London Fire Incident Response Demand & Risk Modelling
problem: Develop an explainable classification model that identifies incidents associated with higher operational response demand while controlling leakage and model risk.

name: NHS Operational Guidance Knowledge Assistant
problem: Build a RAG assistant that answers NHS operational and statistical guidance questions using approved evidence, citations and reliable refusal behaviour.

name: Public Procurement Spend, Supplier Concentration & Contract Risk Intelligence
problem: Build a governed procurement-intelligence solution that helps commercial leaders identify supplier concentration, fragmented purchasing, re-procurement pressure and SME participation from Contracts Finder data.
use_case: Supports commercial portfolio reviews by showing where procurement teams should investigate supplier dependency, fragmented demand or upcoming contract workload before deciding on intervention.
data_source: Contracts Finder — June 2026 OCDS flattened CSV notices

name: NHS Workforce Capacity, Retention & Service Sustainability Intelligence
problem: Create a governed workforce intelligence product that separates headcount, FTE and turnover so leaders can identify persistent workforce capacity and retention pressure.
use_case: Supports workforce planning meetings by helping leaders decide whether a problem warrants recruitment analysis, retention intervention, workforce redesign or further investigation.
data_source: NHS HCHS Workforce Statistics — July 2026 core workforce and turnover extracts

name: Financial Complaints, Conduct Risk & Customer Harm Intelligence
problem: Build a conduct-intelligence view that separates complaint volume from complaint rate, upheld outcomes and closure performance to identify where customer-outcome issues deserve investigation.
use_case: Supports complaints and conduct-risk committees by prioritising firms or products for investigation or enhanced monitoring without presenting analytical flags as regulatory findings.
data_source: FCA Firm-Specific Complaints Data — 2025 H2

name: Telecom Customer Experience & Provider Performance Intelligence
problem: Create a multi-quarter provider and service intelligence product that distinguishes persistent complaint deterioration from temporary spikes and supports targeted root-cause investigation.
use_case: Supports customer-experience reviews by showing which provider/service combinations warrant deeper investigation before resources are redirected.
data_source: Ofcom Telecoms and Pay-TV Complaints — quarterly underlying CSV data

name: Housing Energy Efficiency, Consumption & Retrofit Prioritisation Intelligence
problem: Build an explainable retrofit-prioritisation solution that combines property characteristics, energy consumption and efficiency-measure evidence while keeping investment decisions under human control.
use_case: Supports housing investment workshops by comparing alternative prioritisation scenarios and showing which property segments warrant deeper feasibility assessment.
data_source: DESNZ NEED Anonymised Data 2026 — 50,000-row sample

name: Community Safety, Crime Demand & Resource Allocation Intelligence
problem: Build a longitudinal crime-demand intelligence product that separates persistent change from short-term spikes and supports evidence-led community-safety prioritisation.
use_case: Supports Community Safety Partnership meetings by identifying offence-area patterns that merit multi-agency prevention investigation without stigmatising areas from raw volume alone.
data_source: Home Office Police Recorded Crime Open Data — Police Force Area tables

name: Flood Defence Asset, Investment & Risk Prioritisation Intelligence
problem: Create a transparent flood-investment portfolio view that helps leaders identify schemes requiring earlier review while making funding, delivery and evidence gaps visible.
use_case: Supports capital-programme reviews by showing which schemes need engineering review, funding challenge or additional evidence before investment prioritisation.
data_source: Environment Agency FCERM Investment Programme — 2026–27

name: Government Grants Portfolio, Funding Concentration & Programme Intelligence
problem: Build a grants-portfolio intelligence product that identifies funding concentration, multi-scheme recipients, possible overlap and under-reach without treating funding value as evidence of impact.
use_case: Supports annual portfolio reviews by highlighting patterns that require further due diligence, programme coordination or evaluation before the next funding cycle.
data_source: Cabinet Office Government Grants Register — 2024–25 scheme and award data

name: Road Network Demand, Traffic Pressure & Infrastructure Investment Intelligence
problem: Build a longitudinal road-demand intelligence product that distinguishes persistent traffic pressure from estimated counts, temporary variation and incomplete evidence before capital investment decisions.
use_case: Supports transport investment gateway meetings by identifying corridors that warrant deeper congestion, safety or economic assessment rather than automatically recommending expenditure.
data_source: DfT Road Traffic Statistics — Count Points and AADF

name: Housing Market Affordability, Development & Investment Risk Intelligence
problem: Build a housing-market intelligence product that distinguishes sustained market pressure from one-period price movement and clearly separates price evidence from true affordability.
use_case: Supports housing strategy and development planning by identifying areas that warrant deeper affordability, supply or planning analysis before intervention decisions are considered.
data_source: HM Land Registry UK House Price Index — June 2026 full historical CSV

name: School Attendance, Persistent Absence & Early Intervention Intelligence
problem: A regional education directorate cannot distinguish structural persistent absence from short-term variation or identify which phases and pupil groups need limited attendance-support resources most.
use_case: Support termly attendance reviews by identifying local-authority, phase and pupil-group patterns requiring investigation and early-intervention planning; aggregate data does not identify individual pupils.
data_source: DfE Pupil Absence — geographic and pupil-characteristics CSV datasets

name: Statutory Homelessness, Temporary Accommodation & Prevention Performance Intelligence
problem: A council partnership faces rising temporary-accommodation pressure but cannot separate demand growth, prevention outcomes, relief-duty pressure and prolonged stays.
use_case: Support housing-service redesign and prevention planning by identifying where prevention, accommodation supply or further investigation of long stays is needed.
data_source: MHCLG Statutory Homelessness — England time series and detailed local-authority data, January–March 2026

name: Local Government Financial Resilience, Service Spend & Budget Pressure Intelligence
problem: A council finance directorate needs to identify services driving persistent expenditure growth and where medium-term financial plans require deeper challenge.
use_case: Support medium-term financial planning and service-prioritisation reviews using comparable revenue-outturn trends; assess funding gaps or budget variance only with additional funding and budget evidence.
data_source: MHCLG Revenue Outturn time-series CSV — 2017/18–2025/26

name: Apprenticeship Skills Pipeline, Participation & Achievement Intelligence
problem: A regional skills authority lacks a clear view of changes in apprenticeship starts, participation and achievements across age, level and geographic segments.
use_case: Support skills-funding and employer-engagement planning by highlighting weakening segments; aggregate annual starts and achievements must not be presented as linked learner completion rates.
data_source: DfE Apprenticeships — geography, starts, participation, achievements and population CSV, 2020/21–2025/26

name: Business Insolvency, Sector Stress & Economic Resilience Intelligence
problem: An economic-development team cannot clearly identify where business distress is becoming concentrated by sector, geography and insolvency type.
use_case: Support economic-resilience monitoring and prioritise further business-support investigation using long-run trends and record-level patterns, without interpreting insolvency counts as business failure rates without denominators.
data_source: Insolvency Service Company Insolvency Statistics — June 2026 long-run CSV and England, Wales and Scotland record-level ZIP

name: Aviation Punctuality, Delay & Operational Resilience Intelligence
problem: An airport operations team needs to distinguish persistent airport and airline delay patterns from isolated poor months and changing flight mix.
use_case: Support operational-performance reviews and resilience planning by comparing weighted punctuality and delay patterns across the frozen monthly cohort; causal attribution requires additional operational evidence.
data_source: Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) punctuality — monthly full-analysis CSVs, January–August 2026

name: Regional Trade Exposure, Export Concentration & Market Diversification Intelligence
problem: An economic-development board needs to assess regional trade exposure and whether dependence on a few export markets or product groups creates concentration risk.
use_case: Support regional trade reviews using the core time series; quantify destination or product concentration and diversification opportunities only when the relevant HMRC breakdowns are added.
data_source: HMRC Regional Trade in Goods — England trade-in-goods quarterly time-series ODS, Q1 2021 onward; HMRC country/product breakdowns for concentration analysis

name: Local Net Zero Emissions, Sector Decarbonisation & Intervention Prioritisation Intelligence
problem: A combined authority cannot clearly separate structural emissions, sector mix and realistic local influence when choosing decarbonisation priorities.
use_case: Support net-zero programme reviews by identifying high-emission sectors, slow reductions and local areas warranting feasibility assessment before intervention or funding decisions.
data_source: DESNZ UK local-authority greenhouse-gas emissions — 2005–2024 data-tables XLSX

name: NHS Hospital Activity, Demand, Flow & Capacity Pressure Intelligence
problem: An NHS planning directorate needs to distinguish sustained changes in elective and non-elective activity, admissions and outpatient demand from short-term variation.
use_case: Support operational and service-planning reviews using historical hospital activity trends; capacity constraints and patient-flow causes require additional bed, staffing or pathway evidence.
data_source: NHS England HES Monthly Activity Report — full historical CSV, April 2018–March 2026

name: River Water Quality Classification & Environmental Intervention Intelligence
problem: An environmental authority lacks a governed view of weak ecological and chemical classifications, recorded measures and water bodies requiring further investigation.
use_case: Support catchment intervention reviews by combining classification and measures evidence, exposing coverage gaps and prioritising investigation; recorded measures do not prove environmental improvement.
data_source: Environment Agency Catchment Data Explorer — England classifications.csv and measures.csv
